headline: Public hearing on a seven-unit building at 43 St. Lawrence Street, and a zoning agreement amendment for 76 Congress Street.
summary: The meeting will cover a public hearing on a proposed seven-unit building at 43 St. Lawrence Street. It will also consider an amendment to the conditional zoning agreement for 76 Congress Street.
items: Workshop on a Major Site Plan at 41 Ashmont Street by 509 Forest, LLC for two affordable apartment buildings in the B-1 zone, with 63 units and 10 parking spaces (Plan Number PL-003618-2026). Tabled to a future date at the applicant's request.

Public hearing on a Major Site Plan at 43 St. Lawrence Street by St. Lawrence Development, LLC for a four-story, seven-unit building with seven structured parking spaces, zoned RN-4 Neighborhood Residential (Plan Number PL-003653-2026).

Consideration of an amendment to Conditional Zoning Agreement C-58 for 76 Congress Street by The Hill Arts/Friends of the St. Lawrence Church, to allow changes to the proposed building and remove the zone's expiration date (Plan Number ZN-003712-2026).
location: Room 24 (Basement Level of City Hall) and Zoom

PUBLIC COMMENT INFORMATION: 
To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email planningboard@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions 
must be received by 12:00 pm the day before the Planning Board meeting to guarantee their inclusion in the 
agenda packet. All submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help ensure your 
comment is submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below). 
 
 
AGENDA: 
 
    
WORKSHOP - 4:30 PM 
    
i. Major Site Plan; 41 Ashmont Street; 509 Forest, LLC., Applicant.  The Planning Board will hold a 
workshop to consider an application for the construction of two multi-unit affordable apartment 
buildings in the B-1 zone.  The proposed development includes a four-story, 30-unit building and a 
five-story, 33-unit building, for a total of 63 affordable dwelling units, along with 10 parking 
spaces.  A project and plan summary are available for viewing on the city's CSS Portal 
(https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing Plan Number PL-003618-2026. This item has been 
tabled to a future date at the request of the applicant. 
    
PUBLIC HEARING - 5:30 PM 
    
1. ROLL CALL AND DECLARATION OF QUORUM 
2. COMMUNICATION AND REPORTS 
  Portland Comprehensive Plan 2040 
3. REPORT OF ATTENDANCE AT THE MEETING HELD ON OCTOBER 13, 2026 
  Workshop 
Complete Streets Design Guidelines: Din, Smith, Uhlenhake, and Zamboni present. Messina, 
Robertson, and Silk absent.  
 
Public Hearing 
64 Pine Street: Din, Smith, Uhlenhake, and Zamboni present. Messina, Robertson, and Silk absent.  
 
4. REPORTS OF DECISIONS AT THE MEETING HELD ON OCTOBER 13, 2026 
  i. Major Site Plan Amendment; 64 Pine Street; 64 Pine Street, LLC, Applicant. Smith motioned, 
and Uhlenhake seconded a motion to waive Technical Manual standard Section 1, Standard 
1.5.1.B, which requires two-way driveways to be between 20-24 feet in width and instead 
allow an 18-foot driveway width. Vote 4-0 (Messina, Robertson, and Silk absent). Smith 
motioned, and Uhlenhake seconded a motion to approve the Site Plan Amendment application. 
Vote 4-0 (Messina, Robertson, and Silk absent). Smith motioned, and Uhlenhake seconded a 
motion to adopt the findings contained in the October 13, 2026 Staff Report and draft approval 
letter, and to authorize the Board Chair to sign the approval letter as drafted. Vote 4-0 
(Messina, Robertson, and Silk absent). 
5. NEW BUSINESS 
  i. Major Site Plan; 43 St. Lawrence Street; St. Lawrence Development, LLC., Applicant.  The 
Planning Board will hold a public hearing to consider a major site plan to facilitate the
3 
construction of a four-story, seven-unit building with seven structured parking spaces at 43 St. 
Lawrence Street, zoned RN-4 Neighborhood Residential.  A project and plan summary are 
available for viewing on the city's CSS Portal (https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing 
Plan Number PL-003653-2026. 
  ii. Conditional Zoning Agreement Amendment; 76 Congress Street; The Hill Arts/Friends of the 
St. Lawrence Church, Applicant.  The Planning Board will consider an amendment to the 
Conditional Zoning Agreement (C-58) for 76 Congress Street to allow for modifications to the 
proposed building and remove the zone's expiration date.  A project and plan summary are 
available for viewing on the city's CSS Portal (https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing 
Plan Number ZN-003712-2026.
